clips.preview: Hi there! Welcome to the KPop Demon Hunters Repair Workshop! Pick a stage friend and help them shine like gold again!
clips.heart-ready: All fixed! Now tap the Honmoon heart to wake up the stage, and let's shine again!
clips.checkup-start: Last step, a rhythm checkup! Tap the three glowing circles with the stethoscope.
clips.eczema-healed: A little cool moisture cream, and the red rash is all gone. Smooth as silk!
clips.diaper-fitted: All dried off and into a fresh, cozy diaper! So soft and comfy!
clips.honmoon-sealed: Golden Honmoon Balm! The cracked demon mark is now a shiny golden Honmoon crest!
clips.fart-ready: Ten little toots all charged up! Press once more to launch the MEGA mushroom toot!
clips.fart-mega: KABOOM! MEGA mushroom toot launched! That was so silly!
clips.form-awakened: Awakened Form, go! Shine bright, power of the Honmoon!
clips.form-stage: Back to Stage Idol Form! The star idol is here!
clips.flowerpot-fixed: Wow, the porcelain peony flowerpot is standing up again, and the big peonies look so pretty!
clips.rumi-hello: Hi! I'm Rumi, lead vocal of HUNTR/X! I just fought a shadow demon, and my purple dragon braid and my Saingeom sword got all messy. Can you fix me up?
clips.rumi-thanks: My Saingeom and my golden Honmoon mark are sparkling again! Thank you, little fixer. Come listen to me sing!
clips.mira-hello: Hello! I'm Mira, the main dancer. I practiced so hard that my crimson outfit and my Gokdo blade need a little care!
clips.mira-thanks: My Gokdo shines like new, and my dance moves are full of power again! Here's the coolest stage kiss for you!
clips.zoey-hello: Yay! I'm Zoey, the maknae rapper! I flipped too hard, and my space-bun ribbons and my Shin-kal knives came loose. Help me, please!
clips.zoey-thanks: Awesome! My space buns are fluffy and my Shin-kal are sparkling. Let's rock the whole stage together!
clips.jinu-hello: Hello, I'm Jinu, leader of the Saja Boys. The night wind of the underworld got dust all over my Gat hat and my Bipa lute. Can you help me?
clips.jinu-thanks: My Gat sits straight and my Bipa sings sweetly again! Thank you. Let me play you a starlight melody.
clips.abby-hello: Hey! I'm Abby, the power dancer. I scuffed my wristbands doing a big street-dance move, and my stage vest got muddy. Can you clean me up?
clips.abby-thanks: I'm full of power, and my stage armor is shining! You're the best backstage buddy!
clips.mystery-hello: Shh... I'm Mystery, the mysterious vocalist. My silver bangs and my glowing stand mic have gone a bit dim. Can you light me up again?
clips.mystery-thanks: My glowing mic shines once more. My song will guard your sweet dreams!
clips.romance-hello: Hi, sweetie. I'm Romance, the Rose Prince. My velvet suit and my rose-gold mic got dirty. Will you make me handsome again?
clips.romance-thanks: The red rose on my chest is blooming again! This prettiest rose is for the kindest helper, you!
clips.baby-hello: Hey there! I'm Baby, the maknae. I spilled Soda Pop all over my cat-ear beanie and my hoodie. Please wash them for me!
clips.baby-thanks: Glug glug! The Soda Pop is fizzing, and my cat-ear beanie is fluffy again. Have some sweet soda!
clips.derpy_tiger-hello: Rawr! I'm Derpy, the blue Minhwa tiger. I was chasing a butterfly and knocked over my porcelain peony flowerpot. Help me stand it up!
clips.derpy_tiger-thanks: Rawr-ha-ha! The flowerpot is standing tall, and the peonies smell so sweet. Derpy gives you a happy paw pat!
clips.sussie_magpie-hello: Chirp chirp! I'm Sussie, the six-eyed magpie. I flew under a roof, and my little Gat hat tipped and my six golden eyes got dusty. Polish me up!
clips.sussie_magpie-thanks: Chirp chirp chirp! Six golden eyes sparkling, little Gat hat looking sharp. Sussie brings you good luck!
